newsitem.title: USA: BOSTON PARTNERS PICKS FIELDCREST, BURLINGTON.
newsitem.headline: BOSTON PARTNERS PICKS FIELDCREST, BURLINGTON.

text.p: Boston Partners' Wayne Archambo favors Fieldcrest Cannon Inc and Burlington Coat Factory Warehouse Corp and is "partial" to ESS Technology Inc, according to an article in the August 11 issue of Barron's.
The Barron's article said Fieldcrest is selling around book value and for 11.5 times fiscal year 1998 estimated net of $2.15 per share fully dilluted.

Archambo also said in the Barron's article the shares of Burlington shouldn't be selling at 10 times next year's projected earnings of $1.75 per share. The article also said Burlington's inventory turns have been accelerating and net margins are widening.
In addition, the Barron's article said Archambo sees a revenue rebound at ESS in the fourth quarter, and 1998 earnings of $1.90 per share.
The article also said the company has a "cash-rich" balance sheet, with net cash of $1.75 per share.
